docs.summary: Graphite's high level renderer. The host mutates worlds, materials and globals on its thread and calls [`SubmitFrame`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.Renderer~SubmitFrame), which extracts what changed and hands the frame to the render thread. Resources are created from any thread and become resident on a later frame.
Frame features that are not per world, with the built in Deform and Readback. Host thread.

members.signature: public Renderer(GraphicsDevice device, IShaderCompiler? compiler, RendererOptions? options = null)

docs.summary: Values and keywords every shader can read, overridden per world.
Raised on the host thread at SubmitFrame, once per distinct problem.
Creates a mesh. Any thread, resident on a later frame.
Creates a material. Any thread, setters are host thread only.
The built in skies, each a shader for a material to set as [`Sky`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.EnvironmentDesc~Sky).
A prefiltered cube from a bake, to show through [`Cubemap`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Cubemap). The caller owns it. Any thread.
Loads a shader through the renderer's compiler. Any thread.

Extracts every change since the last frame and queues the frame. Waits for the render thread to finish the previous frame's CPU work first, so at most one frame is being prepared while the host builds the next. Host thread.

members.name: Readback
members.signature: public void Readback(Texture texture, Action<TextureReadback> done, uint mip = 0, uint layer = 0, TextureRegion? region = null)

docs.summary: Copies a texture region to the host after this frame's views, calling `done` on the host thread at a later SubmitFrame, with an error when it could not be read. The whole mip when no region is given. Compressed and depth stencil formats cannot be read back. Host thread.

members.name: Readback
members.signature: public void Readback(DeviceBuffer buffer, Action<BufferReadback> done, uint offset = 0, uint size = 0)

docs.summary: Copies a buffer range to the host after this frame's views, the rest of the buffer when size is 0. Host thread.

The GPU execution of the last frame dispatched, for hosts tracking their own readbacks or staging against it. Set on the render thread before [`Submitted`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.FrameDesc~Submitted) runs, so read it there or after SubmitFrame returns with inline threading.
The counts of the last frame recorded. Any thread.
Shader variants compiling in the background now. Draws needing one skip, or use a ready variant of the same pass, until it is done. Any thread.

members.name: CreateFullscreenProgram
members.signature: public FullscreenProgram CreateFullscreenProgram(string fragment, string name = "Fullscreen", bool source = true, BlendStateDescription? blend = null, bool lit = false, string variant = "")

docs.summary: A fullscreen program for features. The fragment code follows an include giving it vUV, outColor and Graphite_SampleSource(uv), which samples the colour the feature reads in mono and layered views alike, unless source is false. Textures the size of the view are declared GRAPHITE_SCREEN_TEXTURE and read through Graphite_Sample, arrays on layered views. Blend is one override attachment unless given.
docs.remarks: A lit program may include Graphite/Lighting.glsl and Graphite/Shadows.glsl and read the world's lights, shadows, probes and bindless textures as forward passes do; its feature declares [`DrawsRenderables`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.FeatureBuilder~DrawsRenderables).

members.name: CreateProceduralProgram
members.signature: public FullscreenProgram CreateProceduralProgram(string code, string name = "Procedural", BlendStateDescription? blend = null, bool lit = false)

docs.summary: Creates a program making its own geometry from gl_VertexIndex, drawn by features through [`DrawProcedural`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.FeatureContext~DrawProcedural). Its code holds both stages, the vertex one under GRAPHITE_VERTEX, and reads the view through Graphite/Internal/PostView.glsl as fullscreen programs do.
Waits until the render thread has finished the CPU side of the last submitted frame, then hands readbacks and probe bakes the GPU has finished to their callbacks. Host thread.
